# Thinking Beyond

Thinking Beyond is a Nepal-based podcast hosted by Manisha Neupane.

## About

The show explores business and money, mindset and growth, health and performance, and society and perspectives through thoughtful conversations with curious guests.

## Primary pages

- Homepage: https://thethinkingbeyond.com/
- Episodes: https://thethinkingbeyond.com/episodes
- Contact: https://thethinkingbeyond.com/contact

## Official channels

- YouTube: https://youtube.com/@manishaneupane

Use the episode pages and official YouTube channel as the source of truth for current episode details.
